title: Gland Pharma to Invest USD 21 Mn in US Expansion, Acquire 60% Stake in Novelstar Pharma
summary: New Delhi: Gland Pharma Limited has approved an investment of USD 21 million in its proposed wholly owned subsidiary Gland Pharma USA Inc. (Gland USA), which will use the funds to acquire a 60% stake...

contentHtml:
New Delhi: Gland Pharma Limited has approved an investment of USD 21 million in its proposed wholly owned subsidiary Gland Pharma USA Inc. (Gland USA), which will use the funds to acquire a 60% stake in newly incorporated US-based Novelstar Pharma Inc. The company also announced the resignation of Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director Wenjie Zhang and the appointment of Xingli Wang as an Additional Director.

At its Board meeting held on October 1, 2026, Gland Pharma approved the proposed investment in Gland USA. The investment is intended to support the company’s expansion in the United States. Following completion of the proposed investment, Novelstar Pharma will become a subsidiary of Gland USA and a step-down subsidiary of Gland Pharma.

Gland USA currently has a share capital of USD 500,000, which is proposed to increase to USD 21.5 million following the investment. The entity reported nil turnover during FY 2025-26. Gland USA is in the pharmaceutical industry and is currently a wholly owned step-down subsidiary of Gland Pharma, with the proposed structure making it a wholly owned subsidiary.

The transaction involving Gland USA is a related-party transaction as Gland USA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Gland Pharma. The company said the transaction is being undertaken at arm’s length and is exempt from the approval requirements under Regulation 23(5)(b) of the SEBI Listing Regulations because it is between the company and its wholly owned subsidiary, whose accounts are consolidated and placed before shareholders. The Audit Committee and Board of Directors have nevertheless provided prior approval.

The investment of USD 21 million will be made in cash and is expected to facilitate the company’s US business expansion. No governmental or regulatory approvals are applicable for the investment, and the indicative completion timeline is October 31, 2026. There will be no change in Gland Pharma’s proposed ownership of Gland USA, which will remain wholly owned by the company.

Gland USA was incorporated on March 7, 2022, and has a presence in the United States. Its turnover was USD 483,808 in FY2023-24, USD 87,342 in FY2024-25 and nil in FY2025-26.

Under the proposed structure, Gland USA will invest USD 21 million to subscribe to 60% of Novelstar Pharma Inc.’s equity share capital. Novelstar will have a post-acquisition share capital of USD 35 million, while its turnover is currently nil. The transaction is not classified as a related-party transaction.

Fosun Pharma USA Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical (Group) Co. Ltd and a fellow subsidiary of Fosun Pharma Industrial Pte. Ltd., the promoter of Gland Pharma, will hold the remaining 40% equity share capital of Novelstar. Apart from this, the company stated that the promoter, promoter group and group companies have no other interest in the transaction.

Novelstar belongs to the pharmaceutical industry and the proposed investment is intended to facilitate Gland Pharma’s expansion in the United States through a strategic partnership. No governmental or regulatory approvals are applicable, and Gland USA expects to complete the acquisition of 60% of Novelstar by October 31, 2026.

Novelstar was incorporated in the United States on September 30, 2026. It is a newly incorporated entity with no business and therefore has no applicable three-year turnover history.

Meanwhile, Wenjie Zhang, Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director of Gland Pharma, resigned from his position due to his pre-occupations. His resignation was accepted with effect from October 1, 2026. In his resignation letter, Zhang thanked the Board for its support and cooperation during his association with the company and requested the company to complete the necessary filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

The company has appointed Xingli Wang as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive and Non-Independent Director, effective October 1, 2026. Shareholders’ approval required under Regulation 17(1C) of the Listing Regulations will be obtained within the stipulated timelines through postal ballot and e-voting.

Wang, aged 63, is currently President of Fosun Pharma and also serves as Chief Executive Officer of its Global R&D Center and Chief Executive Officer of its innovative medicine division. He is also a Non-Executive Director of Shanghai Henlius, which is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

Wang joined Fosun Group in January 2023 and served as Executive President of Fosun Pharma from January 2023 to June 2025. Before joining Fosun Group, he was a Senior Lecturer in Cardiovascular Medicine at the University of New South Wales in Australia and worked as a cardiologist and professor with tenure at Baylor College of Medicine in the US. He also served as Medical Director of Schering-Plough Corporation and held various positions at Novartis, including Project Supervisor, Global Project Clinical Head, Head of Novartis Global Drug R&D (China) and General Manager of its Biomedical Research Institute in China.

Wang holds a Bachelor’s degree in Medicine from Shandong Medical College and a Doctorate in Cardiovascular Science from the University of New South Wales. He also holds a licence to practise medicine in Australia.

Following the changes to the Board, Gland Pharma has realigned its Board committees with effect from October 1, 2026. The Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Risk Management Committee, Corporate Social Responsibility Committee and ESOP Compensation Committee remain unchanged. In the Stakeholders’ Relationship Committee and Share Transfer Committee, Dr. Jia Ai Zhang has been appointed as a member, replacing Wenjie Zhang.
